difficulty_reason: For the diagram of equation labelled equation-base-change with f and g Tor independent, the lemma asserts that the two transformations L(g')^* -> L(g')^* o a o Rf_* and L(g')^* -> a' o Rf'_* o L(g')^*, built from the units of the two adjunctions, agree through the base change maps beta : Lg^* o Rf_* -> Rf'_* o L(g')^* of Cohomology, Remark labelled cohomology-remark-base-change and alpha : L(g')^* o a -> a' o Lg^* of equation labelled equation-base-change-map, i.e. that the displayed square of transformations commutes (statement lines 1955-1976). The proof is dual to that of Lemma labelled lemma-trace-map-and-base-change; after the usual abbreviation conventions it recalls that beta is an isomorphism and that alpha is defined through the adjoint isomorphism beta^vee : g'_* o a' -> a o g_* of Lemma labelled lemma-flat-precompose-pus (proof lines 1978-1992). It first rewrites the left vertical arrow as a three step composition through the unit and counit of the adjunction ((g')^*, g'_*), using that the composite of unit and counit is the identity, and then exhibits the large triangular diagram whose two squares commute by Categories, Lemma labelled categories-lemma-properties-2-cat-cats, whose triangle commutes by the observation above, and whose pentagon commutes by the dual of Categories, Lemma labelled categories-lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints (proof lines 1994-2030). Since beta and beta^vee are isomorphisms and the outside of the diagram is beta o alpha o eta_f by definition, the lemma follows (proof lines 2032-2034). Identifying the left vertical arrow with the unit-counit composition and locating which category-theoretic identity makes the pentagon commute is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
